entry.name: The World in One Day
entry.program: main.ts (Node 22, standard library only) copies entry.png to /output/entry.png

stories.facts: U.S. warplanes hit a missile launch site on Qeshm Island (U.S. official to Reuters). A fourth tanker caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz; Oman evacuated 24 seafarers from the gas tanker Tara Gas; UKMTO reported a second tanker struck seven nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman.
stories.headline: U.S. jets strike Iran's Qeshm Island as tanker war flares in Hormuz

stories.facts: Ukrainian drones and missiles struck the Crimean Bridge; Reuters verified the main road arch collapsed into the Kerch Strait. Russian ballistic missiles hit the Northern and Southern bridges over the Dnipro in Kyiv, disrupting heating and water. A Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia industrial sites on the morning of 17 Nov killed two and injured 38.
stories.headline: Ukraine strikes the Crimean Bridge; Russia hits Kyiv's bridges

stories.facts: Beijing confirmed Xi Jinping will meet Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin on Thursday 19 Nov on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen — the first-ever trilateral meeting. In Manila on Tuesday, Trump said: "I am the guest of President Xi." A successor to the New START treaty is on the agenda.
stories.headline: Xi to host Trump and Putin in a first trilateral summit

stories.facts: The COP31 presidency's first draft cover decision (18 pages, 144 provisions, published Monday in Antalya) calls for accelerated action to phase out fossil fuels, an immediate transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems, and tripling adaptation finance to at least $120bn a year by 2035. Negotiations president Chris Bowen: "This is a first draft; it won't be the final draft." Ministers took over the talks on Tuesday 17 Nov.
stories.headline: COP31 draft urges fossil-fuel phase-out, $120bn in adaptation aid

stories.facts: The UK, Australia, Canada and Italy issued a joint statement calling on Israel to allow rapid humanitarian aid access through Gaza, describing the situation as catastrophic. The UN warned on 17 Nov that winter rains are worsening Gaza's shelter, sanitation and food security crisis, flooding makeshift shelters and destroying limited food supplies.
stories.headline: Britain, Canada, Australia and Italy urge Israel to open Gaza crossings

stories.facts: U.S. indexes closed lower on Tuesday 17 Nov under pressure from AI and tech stocks: S&P 500 down 1% to 7,340.53, Dow down 1.6% to 50,759.42, Nasdaq down 0.7% to 24,328.38. After the close, Nvidia rose about 4% as results beat expectations, with a fourth-quarter revenue forecast of roughly $130bn.
stories.headline: Wall Street falls on tech sell-off; Nvidia beats after the bell

stories.facts: The Pan American Health Organization announced the United States had lost its measles elimination status after evidence showed uninterrupted transmission for at least 12 months under regional verification criteria.
stories.headline: U.S. loses its measles elimination status

stories.facts: Japan announced fighter jet launches and a strong protest after two Russian aircraft violated its airspace at the start of Tuesday 17 Nov.
stories.headline: Japan scrambles jets after Russian aircraft violate its airspace

stories.facts: The internationally recognised Yemeni government's forces retreated before rapid Houthi advances, withdrawing from the Red Sea coast to defend Aden. The Houthis said they launched five drones toward two pumping stations on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline in the Riyadh area (Reuters).
stories.headline: Yemen's army retreats to Aden as Houthis advance

stories.facts: Field reports from Lebanon on 17 Nov recorded Israeli airstrikes on Houla and al-Mansouri, artillery fire across southern towns, and detonations at Alman al-Shumariya, al-Qusayr and Hebbariyeh.
stories.headline: Israeli airstrikes hit Houla and al-Mansouri as artillery shelled the south

stories.facts: Depardieu withdrew from contesting the charges before a Paris court, admitted wrongdoing and apologised; the conviction for abusing two women during the filming of Les Volets Verts, with its suspended prison sentence, remains in effect.
stories.headline: Gérard Depardieu dropped his appeal and admitted sexual assault; his conviction stands

stories.facts: Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh announced his resignation on Tuesday 17 Nov amid an emerging corruption scandal.
stories.headline: President Khürelsükh announced his resignation amid a corruption scandal

stories.facts: In the U19 Asia Cup final in Oman, Pakistan posted 337/9 (Usman Khan 107); India chased it down with one wicket to spare as Mohit Ulva, unbeaten on 49, struck the final-ball boundary.
stories.headline: India beat Pakistan by one wicket off the last ball, chasing 338, to win the Under-19 Asia Cup final
sources: Dawn / Geo News via headlines roundup of 17 Nov 2026
